note: Same 70s VIRAT clip, frame_skip=15 (141 frames), yolov8n, CPU. DeepSORT = separate YOLO detect + re-ID tracker (baseline). "bytetrack" backend = YOLO.predict() detection linked across frames by a custom greedy IOU tracker (models/ultralytics_tracker.py) -- NOT Ultralytics built-in persist=True tracking, which was found during debugging to silently drop most new-object detections on sparsely-sampled video (frames >0.3s apart); see git history / CLAUDE.md for the root-cause writeup. Higher unique_tracks + lower mean_track_len here reflect the simpler IOU-only linker creating a fresh ID more readily than a motion-model tracker would, in exchange for reliably finding every real detection.
